entities.summary: Joachim Karsch was a German artist. He was born in Breslau (Wrocław) and died in Groß Gandern, Sternberg, Gmina Torzym). In 1932, he won a bronze medal in the art competitions at the Los Angeles Games for his Stabwechsel.
